name: PSprint Visual Configurator B2B
author: dziubin

sections.description:
PSprint Visual Configurator B2B is a premium, high-converting quote builder designed specifically for service-based B2B businesses. Stop losing leads to complex pricing PDFs and start offering an interactive, real-time estimation experience directly on your WordPress site.

Built completely independent of WooCommerce, this lightweight and blazing-fast plugin allows your clients to build their own custom packages, select premium add-ons, and instantly request a formal quote – seamlessly delivering highly qualified leads straight to your inbox.

Key Features

  • Interactive Quote Builder: Real-time price calculation as clients select their base services and add-ons.
  • Dedicated Admin Dashboard: Easily manage your base packages, upsells, pricing, and currency settings from a clean, modern interface.
  • 3 Premium Visual Themes: Choose between ‘Minimalist Light’, ‘Dark Glassmorphism’ (Frosted Glass), or ‘Apple Style’ to perfectly match your brand.
  • Lead Capture Built-in: Collects the prospect’s Name and Work Email before submitting the quote request.
  • AJAX Submission: Zero page reloads. The quote request is sent instantly in the background.
  • Shortcode Powered: Drop [visual_configurator] anywhere on your site to display the builder.
  • Zero Bloat: No dependency on heavy e-commerce frameworks. Pure, native WordPress architecture.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the psprint-visual-configurator folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the new PSprint Configurator menu in your WordPress dashboard sidebar.
  4. Configure your currency, visual theme, base services, and add-ons.
  5. Place the shortcode [visual_configurator] on any page or post where you want the builder to appear.
sections.faq:
How do I display the configurator on my site?

Simply create a new Page or Post and paste the shortcode [visual_configurator] into the content editor.

Where do the quote requests go?

By default, quotes are emailed to the site’s administrator. You can easily change this target email address in the plugin’s Settings panel.

Can I use this without WooCommerce?

Yes! This plugin is a standalone, native WordPress solution. It does not require WooCommerce or any other e-commerce platform to function.
sections.changelog:
2.3.1

  • Enhancement: Rebranded to PSprint Visual Configurator B2B and updated system slugs to meet WP.org guidelines.
  • Security: Added full sanitization and unslashing for all POST requests.
  • Fix: Moved all inline CSS and JS to strict wp_add_inline_style and wp_add_inline_script hooks.

2.2.0

  • Feature: Introduced 3 visual themes (Minimal, Glassmorphism, Apple Style) with dynamic frontend rendering via CSS variables.

2.0.0

  • Feature: Added dedicated Admin Settings Panel for dynamic management of services and prices.

1.0.0

  • Initial release. Core framework and AJAX email logic implemented.
